## Standing operator rules
Never modify files under `ledgerly/customer_export/` without posting the proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and receiving approval from `@mina`.

Never run Bandit on `ledgerly` without invoking it through `./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh` so its custom exclusions and baseline comparison are applied.

When providing test output, paste the exact output rather than paraphrasing.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Fix double-counting of refunds in the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`.

The Tenacity refactor was stopped until next sprint.

## Ruled-out approaches
Increasing the Celery visibility timeout to six hours: duplicate jobs remained stuck/invisible for hours.

## Recent work
The invoice credit path appears to apply `CreditMemo.amount` before deducting `refund_total`; `test_apply_credit_after_refund` still needs resolution. Test setup was optimized with invoice, organization, customer-batch, and frozen-clock fixtures. Targeted suites passed, most recently report tests: 28 passed.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Separate per-document embedding clients: duplicate upserts and unnecessary clients.
- One transaction per vector: replaced with `bulk_upsert()` using one transaction.
- Platform-default CSV encoding: caused UTF-8 failures; use explicit UTF-8.
- A second CSV writer implementation: unnecessary because `ledgerly/io/text_writer.py` already uses UTF-8.
